stem:
A flower that has both male and female reproductive structures is shown.

Which statement best describes an interaction that will allow a flowering plant to reproduce by self-pollination?

options.label: F
options.text: An anther is transferred from a filament to another filament within the same flower.

options.label: G
options.text: An ovule is transferred from the ovary to a petal on a different flower.

options.label: H
options.text: A pollen grain is transferred from an anther to the stigma of the same flower.

options.label: J
options.text: An ovary is transferred from a flower on one plant to a flower on a different plant.

visual_elements: Diagram of a flower with labeled parts: Stigma, Style, Ovary, Ovule, Petal, Anther with pollen grains, Filament
